blurb: Guests can enjoy guided wine tastings at the lakeside tasting room, dine at the Beach Café and Patio Restaurant, and explore estate vineyards. The winery offers a Wine Club with semi-annual shipments and member benefits. The estate includes shaded picnic areas, a café, live music events, and a beach with a dock on a first come first serve basis.
extraNote: 48 hours notice required for dome reservations, allergy notices, or cancellations · No outside food or beverages allowed on estate · Wine Club members may cancel membership after two shipments with 2 weeks notice · Shipping is free for orders of 6 bottles or more
